description.value: Kinton Ramen Sunwood Coquitlam is a Japanese ramen restaurant located inside Sunwood Square, part of one of North America's largest ramen chains with 50+ locations founded in Canada in 2012. The menu centres on customizable bowls with pork, beef, chicken, or vegetarian broth bases paired with a choice of thin, thick, or shirataki noodles. Touring cyclists will find a warm, filling meal with substantial carbohydrate options in a sit-down dine-in setting.
